rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 4 conservative atomic changes. Eligibility to appoint Employee Business Coaches (EBCs): Removal of a franchisee-type restriction materially expands the right to appoint EBCs. Maximum number of Employee Business Coaches: Removing the two-EBC cap is a material change in allowed staffing. Revenue threshold to appoint first Employee Business Coach: Removal of a revenue-based eligibility trigger materially expands EBC appointment rights. Plus 1 additional included change.

oldEvidence.quote: For a PRACTICE (Premium) franchisee, in addition to the NBC you may appoint no more than 2 Employee Business Coaches under the following conditions:
you may appoint no more than 2 Employee Business Coaches
If you make a minimum of $20,000 in Gross Revenues per month for 3 consecutive months, you will be entitled to appoint 1 Employee Business Coach
If the first EBC appointed under (i) makes a minimum of $10,000 in Gross Revenues per month for 3 consecutive months, you will be entitled to appoint a second EBC.

newEvidence.quote: In addition to the NBC you may appoint an unlimited number of individuals to serve as EBCs
you may appoint an unlimited number of individuals to serve as EBCs

In addition to the NBC you may appoint an unlimited number of individuals to serve as EBCs if the individuals have (a) been approved by us and trained by ACNA and (b) have signed an Employee Business Coach agreement with you.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer actual EBC appointments or that any franchisee exercised the expanded right. Do not infer the actual number of EBCs appointed or used. Do not infer that any franchisee actually met or failed the old threshold or that revenues changed.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 8 conservative atomic changes. Parties that franchisor may require to execute Owner's Guaranty for Area Development Agre…: New Area Development Agreement provision grants franchisor right to require execution by individuals and other business entities. Parties that franchisor may require to execute Owner's Guaranty when an Owner is a busine…: Franchisor's right to require execution of Owner's Guaranty expands from individuals to individuals and other business entities. Requirement for Owners to sign Owner's Guaranty for Area Development Agreement: New Area Development Agreement provision requires Owners to sign Owner's Guaranty. Plus 5 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: If you are a business entity, your Owners must sign the Owner’s Guaranty attached to the Franchise Agreement.
we have the right to require that the Owner’s Guaranty be executed by individuals who have direct or indirect ownership in the business entity.

If your spouse is an Owner of the Franchised Business, your spouse must sign a personal guaranty making such spouse individually liable for all obligations of the Franchised Business whether or not such spouse is involved in the operation of the Franchised Business.
making such spouse individually liable for all obligations of the Franchised Business

newEvidence.quote: If you are a business entity, all your Owners (whether or not they are involved in the operation of the Franchised Business) must sign a personal guaranty, which is the Owner’s Guaranty attached to the Franchise Agreement
we have the right to require that the Owner’s Guaranty be executed by individuals and any other business entities that have direct or indirect ownership in the business entity.
A spouse of an Owner is not required to sign an Owner’s Guaranty if the spouse has no ownership interest in the business entity.
making such spouse individually liable for all obligations under the Franchise Agreement
If we enter into an Area Development Agreement with you, you must designate one individual as the responsible owner to direct the business affairs and obligations of the Area
Developer.

If you are a business entity, your Owners (whether or not they are involved in the development of the Development Area) must sign a personal guaranty, which is the Owner’s Guaranty attached to the Area Development Agreement.

If any of your Owners is a business entity instead of an individual, we have the right to require that the Owner’s Guaranty be executed by individuals and any other business entities that have direct or indirect ownership in such business entity.

If your spouse is an Owner of the business entity that executes the Area Development Agreement, your spouse must sign a personal guaranty making such spouse individually liable for all obligations related to the Area Development Agreement, whether or not such spouse is involved in the development of the Franchised Businesses. A spouse of an Owner is not required to sign an Owner’s Guaranty if the spouse has no ownership interest in the business entity that executes the Area Development Agreement.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that non-involved owners were previously not required to sign; the old text already required 'your Owners' to sign. Do not infer that any entity was actually required to execute; this is a right, not an actual execution. Do not infer that any spouse was actually excused; this is a condition that may apply.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 3 conservative atomic changes. Requirement to have at least one Restaurant Manager on duty during all hours of operation: Introduces a new operational staffing obligation requiring at least one Restaurant Manager on duty during all hours of operation. Scope of personnel required to sign the Confidentiality Agreement: Expands the population required to sign the Confidentiality Agreement to include all non-managerial personnel, materially broadening the confidentiality obligation. Deadline to notify franchisor after Operating Principal death, disability, or termination…: Adds a concrete 5-day outer limit for notifying the franchisor after an Operating Principal's death, disability, or termination, changing a timing obligation.

oldEvidence.quote: After an Operating Principal's death, disability or termination of employment, you must immediately notify us, and you must designate a successor or acting Operating Principal within 10 days.

Your Operating Principal (if he/she does not hold an ownership interest in you), General Manager, Manager, Area Manager (if applicable) and the other persons listed in Item 14 must sign our Confidentiality Agreement (Exhibit F to the Franchise Agreement and Exhibit D to the Area Development Agreement) and keep our confidential or proprietary information confidential (see Item 14).

newEvidence.quote: After an Operating Principal's death, disability or termination of employment, you must immediately (but no later than 5 days from the occurrence of such event) notify us, and you must designate a successor or acting Operating Principal within 10 days.

You must have at least one (1) Restaurant Manager on duty at the Restaurant during all hours of operation. That person may be your General Manager or may be someone trained and supervised by your General Manager.

Your Operating Principal (if he/she does not hold an ownership interest in you), General Manager, Manager, Area Manager (if applicable), the other persons listed in Item 14 and all of your non- managerial personnel must sign our Confidentiality Agreement (Exhibit F to the Franchise Agreement and Exhibit D to the Area Development Agreement) and keep our confidential or proprietary information confidential (see Item 14).

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer actual notice timing or enforcement of the 5-day cap. Do not infer actual staffing levels, compliance, or use of a General Manager as the on-duty manager. Do not infer that non-managerial personnel actually signed the agreement or that confidentiality was enforced.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 2 conservative atomic changes. Owner personal participation exemption: Removal of a permission that owners need not participate personally is a clear operational disclosure change. Requirement for at least one owner to actively participate: Change from a recommendation to a direct requirement clarifies the obligation's binding status.

oldEvidence.quote: You and your individual owners need not participate personally m the Store's direct operation
but we recommend that you or at least one owner must actively participate m managing the Store or Mobile Unit

newEvidence.quote: You or at least one owner must actively participate in managing the Store or Mobile Unit

rows.inferenceLimit: The removal of this statement does not imply that owners are now required to be personally present; the new text does not state such a requirement. The change from 'we recommend' to 'must' does not imply that participation was not previously required; the old text also contained 'must'.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 4 conservative atomic changes. Franchisor approval of franchisee manager: Adds a new contractual requirement that the franchisee's manager be approved by the franchisor, increasing franchisor control. Permission for single Operations Manager across multiple franchise territories: Introduces a new conditional allowance for a single Operations Manager across up to three contiguous territories, with franchisor approval and reinstatement right. Requirement to employ Business Development Advisor and Client Care Advisor: Introduces a new discretionary requirement that each Franchised Business employ BDA and CCA roles, with franchisor discretion to change via Operations Manual. Plus 1 additional included change.

newEvidence.quote: Your manager must be approved by us.
We may require that each Franchised Business employ a Business Development Advisor (“BDA”) and a Client Care Advisor (“CCA”), which may be changed at any time by us in the Operations Manual.

If you operate multiple Franchised Businesses under a Multi-Territory Addendum, you may be permitted to designate a single full-time Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of up to three contiguous Franchised Businesses located in the same state and covered by the Multi-Territory Addendum, subject to our approval. We reserve the right to reinstate the requirement that each Franchised Business employ a separate Operations Manager with 120 days’ written notice.

Under an Institutional Owner Addendum, a designated top executive is required to oversee operations, while other owners, partners, or affiliates of the institutional owner firm are excluded from direct operational responsibilities unless otherwise agreed in writing.

rows.inferenceLimit: No inference that approval was actually requested or granted. No inference that the franchisor actually required these roles or that they were employed. No inference that any franchisee used this allowance or that the reinstatement right was exercised.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 2 conservative atomic changes. Operating Principal approval and majority ownership requirement: New contractual requirement that the Operating Principal be approved by the franchisor and hold majority ownership, materially increasing franchisor control over franchisee management structure. Initial Training Program requirement for executive, administrative, and marketing personn…: Removal of an explicit training obligation for executive, administrative, and marketing personnel, reducing franchisee staffing requirements.

oldEvidence.quote: All executive, administrative and marketing personnel actively involved in the management or operation, of the Franchised Business must attend and successfully complete our Initial Training Program (as described in Item 11).

newEvidence.quote: Your Operating Principal must be approved by us and must own a majority interest in your Franchise Business.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the franchisor actually exercised approval or that any franchisee was denied; this is a disclosed obligation. Do not infer that training no longer occurs or that any personnel were affected; this is a disclosed obligation change.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 3 conservative atomic changes. Monthly TAB Revenue threshold to engage a second third-party facilitator: Introduces a material financial condition (monthly TAB Revenue threshold) for engaging a second facilitator. Monthly TAB Revenue threshold to engage each subsequent third-party facilitator after the…: Introduces a material financial condition (monthly TAB Revenue threshold) for engaging each subsequent facilitator after the second. Permitted services that facilitators may offer: The new text replaces the broad facilitator duties with a restriction to two named programs, altering the franchisee's ability to use facilitators.

oldEvidence.quote: You may qualify to engage a Facilitator to form TAB Boards, facilitate your TAB Boards, and provide business coaching.

newEvidence.quote: for your second third party Facilitator, you are earning TAB Revenue of at least $12,000.00 each month
and $6,000.00 for each month for each subsequent third party facilitator
You may engage Facilitators to offer only the HI-MAP Program or the StratPro Process in your discretion.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the franchisee actually earned this revenue or that the threshold was enforced. Do not infer what the HI-MAP Program or StratPro Process are or that any services were actually offered.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Requirement to designate an Executive Owner with at least 1% greater ownership interest a…: New contractual obligation imposing an ownership-structure and unilateral decision-making requirement on the franchisee.

newEvidence.quote: One Owner must have at least 1% greater ownership interest in Franchisee than any other Owner and have the unilateral right to make decisions concerning transfer, winding up, and other decisions impacting the operation and dissolution of the Franchisee and its assets (“Executive Owner”). The Executive Owner is not required to be the Designated Manager but may also serve as the Designated Manager.

rows.inferenceLimit: We do not infer that any franchisee actually changed its ownership structure or that the Executive Owner made any decisions; we only note the introduction of the contractual requirement.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Individual required to complete training for entity franchisees: The role of the individual required to complete training for entity franchisees changes from an owner representative to a manager.

oldEvidence.quote: However, you (or if you are a corporation or partnership or limited liability company, a shareholder or partner or member who has been approved by us) must successfully complete the training program described in Item 11.

newEvidence.quote: However, you (or if you are a legal or business entity a manager who has been approved by us) must successfully complete the training program described in Item 11.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that training was actually completed or that the change affects performance; only the disclosed obligation changed.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Required effort standard for Managing Owner and managerial employees: Removing the 'best efforts' qualifier reduces the required standard of effort for the Managing Owner and managerial employees, a material change in the franchisee's operational obligation.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 6 conservative atomic changes. Franchisee sole responsibility for employment decisions and functions: New material obligation assigns franchisee sole responsibility for employment decisions and functions. Franchisor right to require non-competition agreements from franchisee personnel and owne…: New franchisor discretionary right to require non-competition agreements from franchisee principals and personnel. Franchisee and employee obligation to handle customer complaints, refunds, returns and ad…: New obligation imposed on franchisee and employees for customer complaint and adjustment handling. Plus 3 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: You or Your Designated Operator, who has successfully completed Our training program, must directly supervise and participate in the actual day-to-day operation of the Restaurant
Neither You nor Your Designated Operator may have an interest or business relationship with any of Our business competitors

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 7 conservative atomic changes. Franchisor's right to appoint a manager and charge a service fee: New franchisor discretion to step in, charge a fee, and disclaim liability is a material change to the economic relationship. Minimum manager weekly hours / full-time participation: Introduction of a quantified 38-hour weekly minimum and full-time operating-manager requirement materially increases the franchisee's management obligation. Owner guaranty and assumption of obligations: A new personal guaranty obligation for owners (and possible spouses) materially increases personal liability exposure. Plus 4 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: If you are an individual, you will perform all obligations and conditions of your Master Franchise Agreement or designate and retain at all times an individual to serve as the General Manager under your Master Franchise Agreement.
You will devote sufficient time and resources to ensure full and complete compliance with your obligations to us, your customers, and others.

If you are an individual, you will perform all obligations and conditions of your Master Franchise Agreement or designate and retain at all times an individual to serve as the General Manager under your Master Franchise Agreement. If you are a business entity, you will name an individual as the General Manager to assume primary responsibility for the management of your Outlets.

You and your managers must have sufficient literacy and fluency in the English language to satisfactorily complete the Initial Training Program and communicate with your employees, customers, and suppliers.
As a general matter, subject to the successful completion of training, we do not have restrictions on who you may hire as an on-site supervisor.

If you are a business entity, you will ensure that your owners, agents, employees, and any interested party enter into a confidentiality agreement in a form that is acceptable to us in our discretion.

You will ensure that any of your directors who are not a party to your Master Franchise Agreement, any interested party, manager, and any of your key employees we designate enter into service or employment contracts before they receive or are granted access to any confidential information.
Such service or employment contracts will contain a similar reasonable restraint as imposed pursuant to Articles 8 and 9 of your Master Franchise Agreement.

newEvidence.quote: Your operating manager must devote his or her full time, attention and effort to the franchised business and provide direct, day-to-day supervision of the operation, in accordance with the terms and conditions of your Franchise Agreement and the Operations Manual.
Under the current requirements of the Operations Manual, each manager must devote at least 38 hours per week in the day-to-day operation of your Chatime Restaurant.

Your managing owner is responsible for overseeing and supervising the operation of the franchised business, but we do not require your managing owner to devote his or her full time to the franchised business unless the managing owner is also the operating manager.
The managing owner and operating manager may be the same person.
Before your Chatime Restaurant opens for business, we require that your managing owner and operating manager attend and complete our initial training program to our satisfaction.

As a general matter, subject to the successful completion of training, we do not have restrictions on who you may hire as an on-site supervisor, however they must complete all training and be certified as the manager of the location by the Franchisor.

If at any time your Chatime Restaurant is not being managed by an operating manager who has attended and completed our initial training program to our satisfaction, we are authorized, but not required, to appoint a manager to maintain operations on your behalf.
Our appointment of a manager does not relieve you of your obligations under the franchise agreement.
We will not be liable for any debts, losses, costs or expenses incurred during any period in which we manage the franchised business.
We have the right to charge a reasonable service fee for such management services, and we may cease providing such services at any time.
Each owner of your company must sign a guaranty and assumption of obligations in a form acceptable to us.
We may also require the spouse of any signatory to sign, in our discretion.
Any breach of this guaranty by any such owner or spouse will be deemed a breach of this Agreement.

Each manager of your franchised business and each person who receives training from us or otherwise has access to our confidential information must sign a written confidentiality and noncompetition agreement with your company in a form acceptable to us.
Any breach of such undertaking by any such person will be deemed a breach of the franchise agreement.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the 38-hour requirement was actually met or enforced; it is a disclosed obligation under current Operations Manual requirements. Do not infer that the prior General Manager role is identical to the new operating manager or managing owner role. Do not infer that training was actually completed or that failure occurred; only the disclosed pre-opening requirement.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 5 conservative atomic changes. Franchisee sole responsibility for employees and employment decisions: Removal of a contractual obligation assigning employment responsibility to the franchisee. Obligation to disclose in writing that franchisor is not a joint employer: Removal of a contractual disclosure obligation that limits franchisor joint-employer liability. Prohibition on training attendees having interest in or business relationship with compet…: Removal of a restrictive covenant limiting training attendees' competitive interests. Plus 2 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: You will have sole responsibility for your employees and all acts of your employees, and all employment-related decisions involving wages, benefits, hours of work, scheduling, hiring, firing, discipline, supervision, record keeping, withholding income tax, social security contributions,
Medicare contributions, unemployment fund contributions and all other terms and conditions of employment.

You must disclose to each of your employees in writing, in a form approved by us in advance, that we are not a "joint employer" of your employees and acknowledge that we do not control your personnel policies.
People who must attend training will be identified in the Notice of Key Employees, attached as Addendum B to the Franchise Agreement.
Anyone required to attend training cannot have an interest in or business relationship with any business competitive with the ohDEER concept.

They must also sign a Non-Disclosure, Non-Solicitation and Non-Competition Agreement that requires them to maintain confidentiality of the trade secrets and to conform with the covenants not to compete.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the franchisee no longer has employment responsibility in practice; only that the Item 15 contractual statement was removed. Do not infer that the franchisee no longer makes such disclosures or that franchisor liability changed; only that the Item 15 obligation was removed. Do not infer that training requirements changed; only the identification method was removed from Item 15.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Requirement for spouses of officers/directors/managers/partners/owners to sign the person…: Removal of the requirement that spouses sign the personal guarantee narrows the scope of guarantors, a material change in the franchisee's obligations and the franchisor's security.

oldEvidence.quote: If you are a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or other entity, we require that each of your officers, directors, managers, partners and owners (direct and indirect) and their spouses sign an agreement (Schedule E to the Franchise Agreement) personally guaranteeing and agreeing to perform all your obligations under the Franchise Agreement.

newEvidence.quote: If you are a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or other entity, we require that each of your officers, directors, managers, partners and owners (direct and indirect) sign an agreement (Schedule E to the Franchise Agreement) personally guaranteeing and agreeing to perform all your obligations under the Franchise Agreement.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer when the spouse requirement was removed during the year or any effect on actual guarantees; only the net revision between the 2024 and 2025 FDDs is observed.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 9 conservative atomic changes. Binding nature of confidentiality/covenant agreement: Signing the confidentiality/covenant agreement changed from a franchisor-discretionary requirement to a mandatory obligation. Non-compete restriction on franchisee and manager: A new direct non-compete restriction on the franchisee and manager was introduced. Type of restrictive covenant in agreement: The required agreement added a covenant not to compete, a material new restriction. Plus 6 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: Your Principal Owner must own a minimum of a 10% ownership interest in Franchisee

You must provide comprehensive initial training programs, additional training programs and remedial training programs for your other employees and ensure that your Dolly Llama Shop is at all times under the direct control of the Principal Owner or a Shop Manager and other employees fully trained by you.

We may require each of your owners, Shop Managers and other supervisorial and managerial personnel who will have access to any confidential information to sign a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement in substantially the form of Exhibit J.
Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement in substantially the form of Exhibit J

If you are an entity, all present and future Owners of the equity or your voting rights, including spouses (and family members who live in the same household, excluding minor children) must execute a written guarantee in a form we prescribe, personally, irrevocably and unconditionally guaranteeing, jointly and severally, with all other guarantors, the full payment and performance of your obligations to us and to our Affiliates.

Upon each transfer or assignment of your interest in the Franchise Agreement, or other change in your ownership interests, and at any other time we request, these holders must re-execute a written guarantee in a form we prescribe.

newEvidence.quote: If you are an entity, we do not require that your
designated Manager own an equity interest in such entity.

You or a fully trained and qualified manager (“Manager”), both of whom have completed our training program, must directly supervise and participate in the actual day-to-day operation of the Franchise on a full-time basis.

However, your designated Manager and each of your officers, directors, partners, shareholders or members, as applicable, must execute our standard Confidentiality and Covenant Not To Compete Agreement, a copy of which is attached to the Franchise Agreement as Attachment IV.
Confidentiality and Covenant Not To Compete Agreement, a copy of which is attached to the Franchise Agreement as Attachment IV
Neither you nor your Manager may have an interest or business relationship with any of our business competitors.

If your interest is subsequently assigned to a business entity, each of the entity’s officers, directors, shareholders, partners, and members, plus any individual who owns, directly or indirectly, a 5% or greater interest in the entity must also assume and agree to discharge all of your obligations and comply with all restrictions under the Franchise Agreement.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer actual ownership levels or that any franchisee took advantage of the new rule. Do not infer actual supervision arrangements or that any franchisee used a manager instead of an owner. Do not infer that franchisees actually stopped training employees or that any employee was affected.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Personal guarantee waiver/limitation practice disclosure: New disclosure that the franchisor often waives or limits the personal guarantee is a material change in the disclosed enforceability of a major obligation.

oldEvidence.quote: Each of your owners holding at least a 25% ownership interest in you, or in an entity directly or indirectly holding at least a 25% ownership interest in you, must personally guarantee all of your obligations under the Franchise Agreement and agree personally to comply with every contractual provision—whether containing monetary or non-monetary obligations—including the covenant not to compete.

newEvidence.quote: Despite this contractual obligation, we often waive or limit the guarantee given the sophisticated nature of our franchisees.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 1 conservative atomic change. Owner/spouse financial guarantee of franchisee obligations: New explicit financial guarantee obligation for owners/spouses is a material economic condition change.

oldEvidence.quote: If you are an entity, each owner (i.e., each person holding an ownership interest in you) and the spouse of each owner must sign the Franchise Owner Agreement attached to the Franchise Agreement as ATTACHMENT "D".

newEvidence.quote: By signing the Franchise Owner Agreement, the owner (or spouse of the owner) agrees to: (a) comply with all brand protection covenants, covenants that protect our intellectual property and transfer restrictions set forth in the Franchise Agreement; and (b) guarantee the franchisee’s financial obligations.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the guarantee was actually enforced or that any owner/spouse actually signed or paid; the FDD only discloses the obligation.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 5 conservative atomic changes. Covenant not to compete and confidentiality requirement: Introduction of a new covenant not to compete and confidentiality obligation for franchisees and business managers. Personal participation in day-to-day operations: The obligation changed from mandatory personal participation to allowing a fully trained and qualified manager to fulfill it, a material operational change. Background check requirement for franchisee and manager: Removal of an explicit background check obligation for the franchisee and manager. Plus 2 additional included changes.

oldEvidence.quote: You must participate personally in the day-to-day operation of your Franchised Business, unless we permit otherwise in writing.
You must designate a Business Manager. If you are an individual, then you must serve as Business Manager.
You and any Designated Manager must pass a background check. However, your Designated Manager is not required to have an equity interest in the franchisee, if it is an entity.
Your Business Manager must complete the Initial Training Program to our satisfaction.

newEvidence.quote: You or a fully trained and qualified manager must personally supervise and participate in the day-to-day operation of your franchised Business, unless we permit otherwise in writing.
While you may designate a Business Manager to fulfill your obligations of day-to-day management, though you are still responsible.
Your Business Manager must successfully complete the initial training program, and complete ongoing advance training requirements.
Franchisees and Business Managers are subject to a covenant not to compete along with confidentiality requirements.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the franchisee actually designated a manager or that the requirement was waived; only the contractual obligation changed. Do not infer that any franchisee actually declined to designate a manager; only the contractual requirement changed. Do not infer that background checks no longer occur; only the explicit contractual requirement was removed.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 2 conservative atomic changes. Owner training requirement when Key Person is not an Owner: Introduces a new conditional training obligation on at least one Owner, a material operational change. rows.summary: 2 conservative atomic changes. Franchisor discretion to require spouse of Principal Owner to sign Guaranty and Assumptio…: Adds a franchisor-discretionary right to extend the guaranty obligation to spouses of Principal Owners, materially expanding personal guarantee scope. Requirement for Operating Principal and all managers to sign confidentiality/non-compete…: Introduces an unconditional contractual obligation for the Operating Principal and all managers to sign a confidentiality/non-compete agreement.

We may also require the spouse of any Principal Owner to sign the Guaranty and Assumption of Obligations.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that any agreement was actually signed or enforced; the change is to the disclosed contractual requirement. Do not infer that any spouse was actually required to sign, or that any guaranty was enforced; the change is a new discretionary right.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 3 conservative atomic changes. Prohibition on simultaneous employment by franchisee/designated owner/operations manager: Imposes a new material restriction on franchisee and designated personnel's ability to hold outside employment. Minimum onsite presence for Designated Owner/operations manager: Adds a quantified operational participation requirement not present in the prior year. Requirement to arrange offsite childcare for children under age six: Adds a new operational requirement for franchisees with young children.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 3 conservative atomic changes. Post-termination restriction on dealings with Region employees and franchisees: The post-termination restriction changed from prohibiting business transactions with or diversion of Region employees/franchisees to prohibiting solicitation or diversion, a material change in covenant scope. Franchisee's exclusive control over employee and contractor staffing and management activ…: The list of franchisee-exclusive staffing and management activities was expanded from scheduling/staffing/management to include hiring, firing, disciplining, promoting, and compensating, a clear operational change. Policies and procedures excluded from Brand Standards: The exclusion from Brand Standards changed from employment policies and requirements to security-related and personnel policies and procedures, altering the scope of franchisor standards.

rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 4 conservative atomic changes. Prohibition on interest or business relationship with franchisor's competitors: Adds franchisor advance written approval exception to competitor-relationship prohibition, altering restriction from absolute to conditional. Franchisee obligation to ensure employees provide good customer service and training: Introduces a clear operational obligation for franchisee employees' service quality and training. Franchisee obligation to handle customer complaints, refunds, returns, and adjustments: Adds a new obligation for franchisee handling of customer complaints and adjustments. rows.itemTitle: Obligation to Participate in the Actual Operation of the Franchise Business
rows.summary: 8 conservative atomic changes. 50% commission reduction for non-compliant transactions: Removal of a material 50% commission penalty for non-compliance. Franchisor right to step in and take over a lead/Guest for processing: Removal of a franchisor control right to take over lead/Guest processing.
